mapper.select: SELECT st.id AS student_id, st.student_no, st.name AS student_name, cl.class_name, st.class_id, sc.id AS score_id, sc.usual_score, sc.exam_score, sc.final_score FROM course_student cs JOIN student st ON cs.student_id = st.id LEFT JOIN class_info cl ON st.class_id = cl.id LEFT JOIN score sc ON sc.course_id = cs.course_id AND sc.student_id = st.id WHERE cs.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY st.student_no
